text: Nia borrowed the little drum from Dalia, and she hoped to play a duet with Mateo. Nia said, “I need an answering beat.” Mateo told Nia, “I am not ready for the audience.” Nia said, “I'll perform a solo.” Nia rehearsed a soft beat and a loud beat. Nia played the solo on the little drum before Dalia. Mateo clapped. Nia bowed.
